OUR OPERATING PARTNERS

The QCC Group

The QCC Group brings experience across cannabis cultivation, controlled-environment agriculture, manufacturing, supply chain, marketing, and facility development.

Its specialist team adds practical operating perspective to our ambition for a connected Jamaican bioscience platform.

Principal · Managing Partner

Kurt Parra

Business affairs & supply chain

Kurt oversees business affairs and brings more than 12 years of experience as a Chief Financial Officer and Chief Supply Chain Officer for private equity-backed companies. He entered the cannabis industry in 2014 through an investment in a Los Angeles cultivation business and its subsequent successful exit.

Principal · Managing Member

Markus Kashinsky

Controlled-environment agriculture

Markus has worked in controlled-environment agriculture since 2012. His experience includes leading the design, development, and integration of more than 300 cannabis cultivation and manufacturing facilities, with specialized engineering designs implemented in mechanical systems nationwide.

Founding Member · Cultivation

David Holmes

Cultivation expertise

David brings more than 20 years of cannabis cultivation experience, including responsibility for thousands of harvests across eight facilities in multiple states. In 2019, he received the Lifetime Cultivation Achievement Award at the Global Cannabis Business Awards.
